# Research you<br>can build on.

::: {.lead tag="p"}
R packages for volatility, dynamic distributions, forecasting, and model comparison.
:::

## MSGARCH
:::

::: layout-block
### Markov-switching GARCH models

Estimation and forecasting with Markov-switching GARCH models for time-varying volatility and risk.

::: package-links
[CRAN & documentation ↗](https://cran.r-project.org/package=MSGARCH)[Package paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v091.i04)
:::

    install.packages("MSGARCH")
:::
:::

::: {.package tag="section"}
::: layout-block
[02]{.package-number}

## GAS
:::

::: layout-block
### Generalized autoregressive score models

Tools for estimating and forecasting time-varying conditional distributions using score-driven models.

::: package-links
[CRAN & documentation ↗](https://cran.r-project.org/package=GAS)[Package paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v088.i06)
:::

    install.packages("GAS")
:::
:::

::: {.package tag="section"}
::: layout-block

## eDMA
:::

::: layout-block
### Dynamic model averaging

Dynamic model averaging for applications in economics and finance.

::: package-links
[CRAN & documentation ↗](https://cran.r-project.org/package=eDMA)[Package paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v084.i11)
